$comment: Entries without a page (a tank's `unlisted`, protocols/tanks-vectors.json) shown as a handbook page once one has their scientific name. The rule: packages/schema/src/unlisted.ts (sciKey, pageMatcher), which the site and the Worker use; the iOS app's tests run these cases too. sciKey: the name as compared (NFKC, lower case, one space between words, the words cf. and aff. left out). match: the page `pageMatcher(pages)(kind, sci)` gives, by id, or null: a page's own scientific name first, else a former name (synonyms) no other page has; nothing for one word (a genus), a name two pages share, or another kind of page. Display only: nothing is written back to the tank. The pages are a sample, not the handbook's (two share a former name on purpose).

sciKey.note: letter case and spacing don't count
aff. is left out, with or without its dot
other words stay: a variety is part of the name
full-width letters from a phone keyboard read as plain ones (NFKC)

match.note: as typed on a phone: case and spaces
a former name of a plant
a page's own name wins over another page's former name
a former name only one page has
a former name two pages have names neither
another kind of page: a fish isn't a plant's page
another kind of page: a plant isn't a fish's page
a kind the handbook has no pages of
a genus alone names no page
an undescribed species names no page
another spelling is another name: no guessing
a page without a scientific name (a breed) is never matched
